hero.description: Frontend Developer based in Asunción, Paraguay 🇵🇾, with over 7 years of experience in web development. I specialize in building modern, functional, and maintainable web applications and interfaces, with a strong focus on both user experience and code quality.
hero.social.label: Social media and contact
about.p1: Throughout my career, I've had the opportunity to work on projects for various brands and companies, building interfaces and digital experiences tailored to diverse needs. I started my professional journey at Agencia Web Porta, where I worked on a wide range of projects, from corporate websites to e-commerce platforms.
about.p2: I'm currently part of the team at itti as a Mid-Level Software Engineer, focusing primarily on frontend development with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. I build new features, integrate APIs, develop user interfaces, and optimize existing applications—always striving for cleaner, more maintainable, and more efficient code.
about.p3: I particularly enjoy turning ideas and requirements into functional interfaces, paying close attention to user experience details, and continuously growing as a developer.
